description: An interactive field guide to ESA's Rosetta mission: ten years and four planetary flybys to catch comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko, hibernating far from the Sun, orbiting a 10-billion-tonne body at walking pace, Philae's bouncing landing where escape speed is under 1 m/s, and what the comet's water, oxygen and glycine say about the early Solar System.
og: Orbits at centimetres per second, a landing where one bounce could mean escape, and solar power at 5 AU — Rosetta and Philae, interactive and sourced.
brand: COMET — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
